Aerialite Ore is a Pre-Hardmode ore which generates as Disenchanted Aerialite Ore on Floating Islands upon world generation.
Upon defeating The Hive Mind or The Perforators, the ore is re-enchanted, and its pickaxe requirement drops to Pre-Hardmode standards.
It requires at least a Nightmare Pickaxe or a Deathbringer Pickaxe to mine.

Auric Ore is a post-Moon Lord ore that generates in the Cavern layer after Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth has been defeated.
It requires at least a Blossom Pickaxe to mine.
If the player touches the ore while not equipping either a full set of Auric Tesla armor or the Seraph Tracers, they will suffer Auric Rejection.
This causes all Auric Ore on screen to flash bright blue, dealing 300 damage to the player and knocking them backwards at 40 (150 tiles/second) velocity on contact.

Hallowed Ore is a Hardmode ore that generates in Pearlstone Blocks, Hardened Pearlsand Blocks, Pearlsandstone Blocks, and Pink Ice Blocks after all three Mechanical Bosses have been defeated.
As such, it predominantly generates in the Underground Hallow biome.
It requires at least an Adamantite Pickaxe, Titanium Pickaxe, or Shardlight Pickaxe to mine.
== Crafting == === Recipe === === Used in === == Notes == *Hallowed Ore has a Metal Detector Object Value of 690, meaning it will be prioritized above Gelatin Crystals but below Chlorophyte Ore.

Perennial Ore is a Hardmode ore which generates in Dirt and Stone Blocks in the Cavern layer after Plantera has been defeated, and is used to craft Perennial Bars at an Adamantite Forge or a Titanium Forge.
It requires at least a Pickaxe Axe or a Drax to mine.
*Although Perennial Ore cannot generate in Pearlstone Blocks, Crimstone Blocks, or Ebonstone Blocks, it can still generate in Dirt Blocks in those biomes.
**Perennial Ore cannot generate in Astral Dirt or Astral Stone.

{{infobox wrapper |{{item infobox | type = Block | type2 = Ore | type3 = Crafting material | placeable = yes | consumable = yes | auto = yes | pickreq = 210 | stack = 9999 | use = 15 | debuff = Burning | debuffduration = While in contact | debuffchance = 100% | color = #A75016 | rare = 8 | value = 850 | sell = | research = 100 | hardmode = yes | proj = Lava Chunk.gif | projcaption = Lava Chunk }} | }} Scoria Ore is a Hardmode ore that generates naturally in the Abyss.
It can generate on the underside of the floating Abyss Gravel or Pyre Mantle islands, dropping harmful lava particles into the water beneath itself.

Like Meteorite and similar blocks, making direct contact with Scoria Ore inflicts the player with the Burning debuff, which can be prevented if the player has equipped any accessory that provides immunity to Burning.
It requires at least a Picksaw to mine and is used in the crafting of Scoria Bars at a Hardmode Forge.

Astral Ore is a Hardmode ore that generates in the Astral Infection after the Wall of Flesh or Astrum Aureus have been defeated.
When the Astral Infection meteor lands and the biome is generated, all existing ore within the infected area is converted into Astral Ore.
Astral Ore requires a pickaxe with a pickaxe power of 210% or greater to mine.

It requires at least one of the Luminite Pickaxes to mine.
== Tips == *Since the ore has a decent sell price, this can be a good option for players to get large amounts of money.
== Trivia == *Its name is likely a reference to the , the most distant layer of a planet's atmosphere which merges with interplanetary space.
It also spawns in high numbers during a Meteor Shower and rarely drops from Meteor Heads.
A Meteorite crash site is a mini-biome guaranteed to spawn after the Eater of Worlds or Brain of Cthulhu is defeated for the first time.

Contact with Meteorite blocks causes the player to be inflicted with the Burning debuff, unless the player has the Obsidian Skull accessory (or its upgrades) equipped, or is using an Obsidian Skin Potion.
* If a player places at least 75 pieces of Meteorite, they can create an artificial Meteorite biome, where all enemy spawns are replaced with Meteor Heads.
{{quotation|The Guide|}} Hellstone is a pre-Hardmode ore that can be found in The Underworld.
Mining it requires at least a Nightmare/Deathbringer Pickaxe, and it cannot be mined with explosives in pre-Hardmode.
Hellstone inflicts the Burning debuff on players who touch it, which can be negated through items such as the Obsidian Skull and Obsidian Skin Potion.
* Hellstone is the only ore of which its bar requires another material (Obsidian) in addition to the ore to smelt.

After Hardmode starts, Mud Blocks located near Jungle grass blocks (naturally in the Underground Jungle) in or below the bottom half of the Underground layer will occasionally be replaced by Chlorophyte Ore.
It requires at least a Pickaxe Axe or Drax to be mined, whose materials require defeating all three mechanical bosses.
Chlorophyte Ore can only spread and convert blocks if it is in or below the bottom half of the Underground layer.
See Mechanics section for details about generation and spread of Chlorophyte Ore, and the difference of mechanics of Chlorophyte Ore in special world seeds.
It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on the surface.

Amethyst is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
It can be obtained in the following ways: * Mining the naturally generated placed form, Gemstone Blocks form with noticeable purple gemstones embedded in it, or Gem stash background object form.
: Rarely, Amethyst can be found in bulk in its own Gemstone Cave micro-biome, or in one that contains other gems as well.
Like all other gems, Amethyst can be placed on blocks, and can be crafted back into its Gemstone Block form at a Heavy Assembler in a Graveyard biome.

The Life Crystal is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's health capacity by 20, adding a red heart to the player's health bar, while also restoring 20health.
Life Crystals can be found naturally placed in any area in the Underground layer and below, though they are fairly uncommon.
They cannot be found in the Underworld or the Dungeon.
Up to 15 Life Crystals can be used per player, increasing health capacity by 300 health (15hearts).
Crystal Shards are a common Hardmode crafting material found in the Underground Hallow.
Crafting all items, including only one color of Phasesaber and excluding consumables and furniture, requires a total of 90 Crystal Shards.
The amount required to craft every weapon and every color of Phasesaber is 290 Crystal Shards.
